Trunk Hazard Area:
38.31667N, -125.98333W

The identified locations above are designated a hazardous warning area(s) for space vehicle reentry. A space vehicle may reenter within this/these area(s) between the dates and times listed. The U.S. Coast guard is establishing this/these hazardous warning area(s) to protect vessels and waterway users from the potential hazards created by reentry vehicle splashdowns and recovery operations.
